verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vertex AI as a platform for building your own agents, and MCP servers (Cloud Run MCP, MCP Toolbox) that let external AI clients operate on Google Cloud resources. Neither is a built-in assistant inside the product to which a user can delegate tasks: the first is a developer building block and the second serves outside agents. No in-console AI assistant is documented, and the axis applies to a cloud platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
